newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: POLISH BANKS EYEING MARKET, OFFICIAL SAYS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANKS EYEING MARKET, OFFICIAL SAYS.

text.p: Several Polish banks are interested in operating in Lithuania, a senior Polish banking official said on Friday.

"Several Polish banks are interested in working in Lithuania," Wojciech Kwasniak, deputy director of the general inspectorate of banking supervision of the National Bank of Poland, told a news conference.
He declined to name any of the banks.
"Polish banks will come to Lithuania following their clients who are interested in investing in the country," Kwasniak said.
"At the beginning they will carefully observe Lithuania's market, the activities of Lithuanian and other Polish banks which are operating in Lithuania," he added.
Polish Kredyt bank SA will be the first foreign bank to open its branch office in Lithuania. Bank Polska Kasa Opieki SA has a representative office in Vilnius.
Lithuanian and Polish bankers were in Vilnius for a two day seminar to exchange views on banking and tax legislation, management of bad loans and deposit insurance systems in the two countries.
The practice of central banks, liquidity and merger posibilities and money laundering prevention will be on Saturday's seminar agenda. --Andrius Vilkancas, Vilnius newroom + 370 2 22 35 17
